high.title: Pertamax Price Could Rise Again, Here's Bahlil's Answer
high.summary: Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia confirms non-subsidized fuel prices will continue following market conditions after Pertamax rose from Rp 12,300 to Rp 16,250 per liter. This significant fuel price increase directly impacts consumer costs and inflation expectations in Indonesia.

high.title: After Strengthening, IHSG Closed Red Today
high.summary: IHSG closed down 0.28% at 5,896.03 after reaching 6,010.48 earlier in the day. The index has fallen 17.96% in the past month and is down 29.68% year-to-date in 2026, indicating significant market volatility.

high.title: 615 Stocks Rise, IHSG Up 2%
high.summary: IHSG closed up 2.07% at 6,007.65 with strong market participation showing 36.91 billion shares traded. This represents a significant recovery from recent losses, providing positive sentiment for Indonesian equity markets.

high.title: Government Says It Held Back Pertamax Price Increases for Months
high.summary: Government justifies fuel price hikes citing global oil price increases since March, with Pertamax rising to Rp 16,250/liter and Pertamax Green to Rp 17,000/liter. This policy decision reflects Indonesia's struggle with global commodity price pressures and subsidy burden management.

high.title: MBG Program Wastes Rp 1 Trillion Per Month
high.summary: The Free Nutritious Meal program has expanded beyond targets with 27,877 kitchen points instead of planned 21,000, causing budget overruns of Rp 1 trillion monthly. This massive fiscal inefficiency in a key government program raises concerns about budget management and program oversight.

medium.title: Threatened to Be Left by Partners Due to SNI, Tire Giant Complains to Task Force
medium.summary: PT Goodyear Indonesia Tbk (GDYR) requests acceleration of SNI certification for its German factories as current certifications expire in September and October 2026. The company needs extension until January 2027 to build required in-house laboratories, affecting its 14 export destination countries.

medium.title: Ferry Fare Increase Requested, Transport Minister Still Considering
medium.summary: Transport Minister Dudy Purwagandhi is considering ferry operators' requests for fare increases due to rising fuel costs and weak rupiah. The decision will balance industry needs with subsidized fuel benefits already provided to ferry services.

medium.title: PLN Apologizes, Reveals Current Electricity Supply Conditions in Java
medium.summary: PLN clarifies that Java's electricity system is operating normally despite operational constraints that reduced power supply in some areas. The company denies blackout rumors and continues efforts to maintain reliable electricity supply for all customers.

medium.title: 3 Luxury Apartments in Jakarta Seized by Tax Officers, What Happened?
medium.summary: Tax authorities seized three luxury apartments worth over Rp 1 billion in Kelapa Gading from a steel industry taxpayer after failed collection efforts. This enforcement action demonstrates the government's serious approach to tax compliance among large taxpayers.

medium.title: AHI Holds AGMS, Approves Rp 548 Billion Dividend and Strengthens Expansion
medium.summary: PT Aspirasi Hidup Indonesia Tbk (ACES) approved Rp 548.02 billion cash dividend or Rp 32.01 per share, representing 82% payout ratio. With 9.7% dividend yield based on current stock price, this reflects strong shareholder returns and business transformation success.

medium.title: Samator Strengthens Shareholder Value Through Rp 35 Billion Dividend
medium.summary: PT Samator Indo Gas Tbk (AGII) approved Rp 35 billion cash dividend or Rp 11.42 per share, reflecting strong financial health after completing strategic investment projects. The company can now focus on asset optimization and value creation from completed investments.

medium.title: TIMAH Earns Rp 1.3 Trillion Profit, Distributes Rp 656 Billion Dividend
medium.summary: PT TIMAH Tbk distributed Rp 656.8 billion dividend, equivalent to 50% of net profit of Rp 1.31 trillion. Revenue increased 6.41% to Rp 11.55 trillion with strong EBITDA of Rp 2.76 trillion, demonstrating solid operational performance.

medium.title: TIMAH Restructures Board of Directors, Deputy CEO Position Eliminated
medium.summary: PT TIMAH Tbk restructured management by eliminating Deputy CEO position and appointing Harry Budi Sidharta as Director of Corporate Strategy and Business Development. The company also changed HR Director role to Director of HR and Corporate Transformation.

medium.title: Trenggono Proposes Additional Rp 30 Trillion Budget for 600 Fishing Villages
medium.summary: Maritime Minister Sakti Wahyu Trenggono requests additional Rp 30 trillion budget for 2027 beyond the indicative ceiling of Rp 15.63 trillion. The funds will support fishing village development and blue economy programs as national priorities.

medium.title: Indonesia Has First Radioactive Testing Lab for Fishery Products in Southeast Asia
medium.summary: Indonesia opened its first ISO 17025 accredited radioactive contamination testing laboratory for fishery products in Cipayung, Jakarta. The facility received BAPETEN and US FDA approval, specifically supporting shrimp export competitiveness to the United States and other countries.

medium.title: Tax Manipulation and Money Laundering, Three People Sentenced to Prison
medium.summary: East Jakarta District Court sentenced three defendants for tax crimes and money laundering through PT GTS, with prison terms ranging from 2 years 8 months to 3 years 4 months plus significant fines. This case demonstrates serious enforcement against corporate tax manipulation schemes.
